training_cutoff_rule: For each target t, use only draws 1..t-1. Pass a draw list truncated through the target row to the frozen B prediction function, and update model reliability only after scoring the target outcome. This append-only historical refresh extends the original fixed evaluation range from 401..1249 to 401..1250; target 1250 is scored using training through 1249. No target draw or later row is passed to its prediction function.

source_models.source_note: This is a new three-line disjoint portfolio allocator over the existing frozen 11-model B/AC signal set. It is not an independent signal-family claim and does not reuse E019 outcomes as evidence.

line_selection.global_support: Existing frozen rolling reliability-weighted support across all 11 models.
line_selection.candidate_pool: Among numbers not used by earlier lines, sort by descending role score, descending global support, then ascending number; retain the first 16.
line_selection.ticket_objective: Enumerate all six-number combinations in the candidate pool and maximize sum(role_score) - 0.022*abs(odd_count-3) - 0.020*abs(count_at_most_22-3) - 0.010*max(0,consecutive_pairs-2) + 0.004*occupied_decade_bands.
line_selection.cross_line_rule: Numbers selected in an earlier line are unavailable to every later line. Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines and exactly 18 unique numbers are required.

random_comparator.method: For each target, apply a uniformly sampled permutation of labels 1..45 jointly to the three fixed model tickets. This preserves exactly three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union size 18, and the target-specific incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched null; sample overlapping contiguous blocks, preserving the fixed final remainder-block length.
inference.block_share_method: Non-overlapping consecutive 50-target blocks; include the final remainder block.

prospective_confirmation.readiness_rule: Historical gate results are diagnostic only. Do not write STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines until the policy owner has explicitly specified the minimum prospective target count and completion rule.

promotion_rule: This is an append-only cutoff refresh of E045, not an independent research axis. It uses the exact same frozen model sources, role order, selection rule, random comparator, random seed, family alpha, per-metric alpha, bootstrap method, bootstrap replicate count, 50-target block length, and 0.65 block-share threshold. Only one newly available target (1250) is appended to the historical evaluation. No model variants, parameter changes, threshold changes, alpha changes, block-size changes, comparator changes, or unbounded microvariants are allowed. Historical results remain diagnostic only; prospective confirmation is still required and unspecified, so this refresh cannot create STRICT_PASS_READY or release purchase lines.
source_data_hash_scope_note: The frozen prefix is constructed by counting non-empty CSV draw records, preserving internal and trailing blank lines, and stopping after round 1250. It covers the header plus exactly rounds 1..1250. The full-file hash matches this prefix because the current source contains exactly 1250 non-empty draw records.

extension.purpose: Align the latest primary historical portfolio evaluation cutoff with the latest verified source cutoff without changing the frozen E045 model or inference policy.
